title: A coax restart resumes the conversation
body:
Quitting coax ends the ACP session; the conversation is gone from the screen
on the next start.

## Proposal

ACP's session/load and session/resume, when the agent advertises them,
with the session id kept in a file under the project's directory so coax
can reopen the last session. The transcript is rebuilt from the replayed
updates through `Transcript::apply`, which already handles them.
